scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.db:up: docker run -d --name decel-db --restart unless-stopped -e POSTGRES_USER=decel -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=decel-prod-2026 -e POSTGRES_DB=decel -e TZ=Europe/Stockholm -e PGTZ=Europe/Stockholm -p 5432:5432 -v decel-db-data-prod:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16-alpine
scripts.prod: pnpm run db:up && pnpm run db:push && pnpm run db:seed && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
